title: Review rhythm: calendar, less checking, rebalance by rule
objectives: Set a fixed review calendar and a checking cadence for clients.
Explain why frequent checking makes normal swings feel like losses.
body_md:
Review rhythm. Fixed calendar: a full review once or twice a year, on dates agreed in advance, not triggered by headlines. Encourage less checking: suggest clients look at their portfolio monthly or quarterly, not daily. Frequent checking makes normal swings feel like losses. Rebalance by rule: use the agreed band, which forces selling some of what has risen and buying what has fallen, the opposite of what emotions suggest.

> **Investor takeaway:** Check progress against your goal, not the daily news.
example: Client checking daily and stressed: move to quarterly reviews — daily moves are noise for a 10-year goal.
say: A full review once or twice a year, on agreed dates.
Frequent checking makes normal swings feel like losses.
never: Check the portfolio daily for a 10-year goal.
